content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status at the **preferred** level with a single minimal in-sentence edit to § 2.1: "no minimum quantity" replaces the USD 2,000,000 minimum, and "on a usage or ordered basis, without take-or-pay obligation" replaces the take-or-pay/no-exit language. This drops the duplicative negative covenant flagged by the verifier (Vendor already acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment in § 12.3) and brings the changed-character ratio within the 0.600 official gate (validated ok:true).
